correctness.rationale: Equality of partial maps in f²=f forces every image point into the domain and fixes it; conversely these conditions suffice. Thus Y∩dom(f)=Y∩im(f)=J, and each fixed y in J is a named root. On Z the undefined points, the free leaves over each named root and the stars with free roots partition Z. Units permute Z only, so the stated profile is necessary and sufficient, and the stabilizer consists of the indicated permutations of undefined points, leaves and equal-size free stars. The independent ordinary-series factors follow directly. Choosing the labeled image set gives r+1 choices, including undefined, per remaining free point; the labeled components also give the stated exponential series. For fixed s≥1, the coefficient of P(z)/(1−z)^s is the convolution with binomial(j+s−1,s−1). With lambda=pi/sqrt(6b), Hardy–Ramanujan gives p(b−j)/p(b)=(1+o(1))exp(−lambda j) uniformly for bounded lambda j. For j≤b/2 use a uniform exponential majorant in lambda j; for j>b/2 bound by p(floor(b/2))/p(b) times a polynomial. The normalized Riemann sum has integral Gamma(s)/(s−1)!=1, giving the claimed pole transfer. The unrefined total has leading pole correction s=a+1, whereas exactly k omissions give (a choose k) times the correction s=a−k+1. Their ratio gives the stated law and the first nonzero omission term dominates for a≥1. The edge cases a=0, b=0 and the empty map fit the profile. The nested finite checker was inspected, not rerun.
residual_risks: The asymptotic estimates are for fixed a and fixed k; no uniform law for growing a is checked.
The exhaustive checker covers only the stated finite ranges and is not the asymptotic proof.

Rooted-star graph isomorphism and the partition asymptotic are known inputs, and the unrefined a=0 sequence is an exact known slice. checked_sources: Araújo et al. Lemma 4.25 and OEIS A000070 for the prior skeleton and exact slice
value.rationale: For a natural partial transformation monoid, the theorem enumerates orbits and determines each stabilizer rather than only counting labeled maps. It identifies the fixed-set effect on partition-scale growth and quantifies that almost every class defines all its distinguished points, a feature lost by forgetting the named roots. The value is in these combined enumerative and asymptotic consequences, not in rediscovering ordinary partitions or graph isomorphism.
residual_risks: Only idempotents, a fixed distinguished-set size in the limit, and uniform sampling of orbits are covered; this is not an asymptotic claim for all partial maps or for uniform labeled sampling.
